major_work.name: Smart Money Walk-Forward Independence & Universe Sensitivity Audit

low_volatility_cd_etf_sensitivity.name: KODEX CD금리액티브(합성)
low_volatility_cd_etf_sensitivity.interpretation: 35bp assumed round-trip cost flips every persisted CD-rate ETF event from gross success to net failure; gross hit-rate is therefore highly universe-sensitive.

statistical_validity.reason: 128 persisted signal events are not 128 independent trials. Five-day forward windows overlap heavily within stocks, many dates are shared across correlated stocks/ETFs, and only 60 unique signal dates exist.
contamination: cross-sectional correlation on shared market dates
fixed 35bp cost assumption is inappropriate for cash-like ETF and may not represent stock-specific execution
required_retest: purge overlapping forward windows within each instrument
cluster/bootstrap by trading date and instrument
report stock-equal-weight and event-weighted metrics separately
run cost sensitivity grid rather than one 35bp assumption
compare against direction/base-rate and simple momentum/volume baselines
regime split only after effective sample size is reported
